page_title: AUG 2-2 RBL | Augsburg v RB Leipzig 10/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+5' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Benjamin Brand didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90+3' Augsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

90+2' That's unlucky! Arne Maier (Augsburg) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to Augsburg.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
85' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Lois Openda, but Finn Dahmen displays great awareness to stop him.
84' Marco Rose has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) replacing Xavi Simons.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Arne Maier (Augsburg) replaces Ruben Vargas.

82' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) steps up to the penalty spot. He attempts to confuse the goalkeeper by stopping in the middle of his run up and sends the ball to the bottom right corner, but Finn Dahmen keeps his cool to thwart him.
81' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Finn Dahmen (Augsburg) was quite harsh and Benjamin Brand didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
81' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is going to take the penalty!
80' The RB Leipzig players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
79' There's a break in play and referee Benjamin Brand must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by RB Leipzig using VAR. This could be interesting!
79' The game is interrupted now, Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

78' Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
77' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
75' Arne Engels (Augsburg) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
74' David Raum (RB Leipzig) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
72' Marco Rose has decided to substitute Benjamin Sesko and he is replaced by Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig).
72' The attendance is 30000.
70' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
68' The game has come to an end for Willi Orban. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig).
68' Jess Thorup has decided to make a change. Pep Biel (Augsburg) replaces Phillip Tietz.
68' Substitution. Fredrik Jensen leaves the pitch and is replaced by Arne Engels (Augsburg).
67' Substitution. Kevin Kampl is replaced by Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig).
67' Substitution. Dani Olmo walks off the pitch and Eljif Elmas (RB Leipzig) comes on as a substitute.
64' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
63' Poor challenge! Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) is penalised for tripping and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle. Augsburg will take a free kick near the side line.

60' 2 - 2 Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Peter Gulacsi is just a bystander as the ball flies into the left side of the goal. The score is 2:2.
59' Peter Gulacsi pulls off a great save to deny Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
57' A goal, which was scored by Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig), was disallowed due to offside.
56' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
55' Benjamin Brand shows a yellow card to Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) for his blatant foul.

52' 1 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Dani Olmo sends a superb cross into the box. Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) latches on to it and from near the penalty spot powers a header into the top left corner, leaving Finn Dahmen beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 1:2.
51' The RB Leipzig players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
48' David Raum (RB Leipzig) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
46' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

44' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. RB Leipzig will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
42' A cross into the box picks out Lois Openda (RB Leipzig), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot well wide of the right post.

39' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) makes it 1:1. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from David Raum and planted his close-range header into the top right corner. Finn Dahmen was helpless.

35' 1 - 0 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a great shot into the bottom right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Peter Gulacsi, so the score changes to 1:0.

33' Good chance! Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
32' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.

31' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Finn Dahmen pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
30' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Finn Dahmen intercepts the ball.
27' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move. Augsburg are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
27' Iago (Augsburg) commits a foul and Benjamin Brand immediately signals a free kick. RB Leipzig have been awarded a free kick.
23' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
22' Augsburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
18' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

18' What a save from Finn Dahmen! Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to RB Leipzig.
17' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
17' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick.
16' Iago (Augsburg) attempts to find Phillip Tietz, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
14' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
11' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) tries to find Ruben Vargas, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
5' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
4' PENALTY APPEAL after Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
1' The linesman signals that Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and RB Leipzig will have the kick-off.
Benjamin Brand will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
